# Forms and validation (AP-FRM)

[Back to catalog](index.md)

## AP-FRM-01

**Persistence entity bound directly to a form** — severity **major**, automated (tool), principles P-06.

**Why it hurts.** Binding EF entities to forms leaks persistence concerns into UI, risks over-posting and tracks changes unintentionally.

**Fix.** Bind a view model/DTO and map it in the application layer, as the repository does.

**Bad:**

```razor
<RadzenTemplateForm TItem="Customer" ...>  (Customer is a DbSet entity)
```

**Good:**

```razor
<RadzenTemplateForm TItem="CustomerEditModel" ...>
```

**Detection:** scanner: TItem compared with DbSet<T> entity types.

## AP-FRM-02

**Submit without busy/double-submit protection** — severity **minor**, automated (scanner, absence check), principles P-08.

**Why it hurts.** Users can submit twice while the first request runs, creating duplicates.

**Fix.** Disable the submit button while busy (RadzenButton IsBusy/Disabled) and ignore re-entrant submits.

**Detection:** files `*.razor`; pattern `<RadzenTemplateForm\b[^>]*\bSubmit\s*=`; reported when the file lacks `\bIsBusy\s*=|\bDisabled\s*=|\bdisabled\b`.

## AP-FRM-03

**Client-only validation** — severity **major**, manual review (G7), principles P-06, P-07.

**Why it hurts.** Validation in the component only improves UX; the server must enforce business rules.

**Fix.** Confirm the trusted layer validates the same rules (discovery → validation).

## AP-FRM-04

**Swallowed exception** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-12.

**Why it hurts.** An empty catch hides failures; the UI shows success while the operation failed.

**Fix.** Handle the specific exception, show a safe message, log it; or let it propagate to the error boundary.

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.cs`; pattern `catch\s*(\([^)]*\))?\s*\{\s*\}`; test files excluded.

## AP-FRM-05

**Template form without validators** — severity **minor**, automated (scanner, absence check), principles P-08.

**Why it hurts.** A RadzenTemplateForm without validators submits invalid input and shows no field messages.

**Fix.** Add Radzen validators or the DataAnnotations validator used by the repository.

**Detection:** files `*.razor`; pattern `<RadzenTemplateForm\b`; reported when the file lacks `Validator\b`.
